heard: Ahab is gone, and Moab rebels against the throne Ahaziah falls through the lattices in his upper room Injured and ill, he sends word out to the coast Go ask Baal-Tzebub, the god of Ekron, about the hope Is there no God in Israel that you must go ask? The God of Ekron for a sign and a task. You will not get up from the bed you are lying on. You will surely die as the Lord has spoken. The angel of the Lord speaks to Elijah the Tishbite
